title: CHEMICAL REACTION ENGINEERING
description: Design of chemical reactors for economical processes and waste minimization. Contacting patterns, kinetics and transport rate effects in single phase and catalytic systems.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CHE 312 and (CHE 333 or 333H).
A minimum grade of C is required in CHE 312, CHE 333 and CHE 333H.
